guard: the manager canonicalizes placed spawn directories, refuses missing paths, and forwards the answered cwd to the real seat
why: Issue #1616 requires the serving manager to answer the canonical host path and launch the seat there.
The suite invokes the registered commands through a real authenticated broker and reads process.cwd() from the real child.
A manager row alone could repeat the requested path while the runtime starts elsewhere.
Issue #385 item 2: a spawn naming a host-local cwd the serving manager cannot resolve must be refused at admission, before anything is minted, with the path, the reason and the host named.

mutations.name: M1 return the alias spelling instead of the canonical path
mutations.expectRed: resolve-cwd answers one canonical directory for a symlink and its target
mutations.cell: resolve-cwd answers one canonical directory for a symlink and its target

mutations.name: M2 fall back to the workspace root for a missing directory
mutations.find: return { refusal: `path cannot be resolved: ${(error as Error).message}` };
mutations.expectRed: resolve-cwd refuses a missing directory by name with failed-precondition
mutations.cell: resolve-cwd refuses a missing directory by name with failed-precondition

mutations.name: M3 drop the answered cwd before spawning the real seat
mutations.expectRed: a placed spawn's seat starts in the directory resolve-cwd answered
mutations.cell: a placed spawn's seat starts in the directory resolve-cwd answered

mutations.name: M4 let a spawn naming an unresolvable cwd through admission
mutations.expectRed: a spawn naming a directory the serving host cannot resolve is refused at admission with the path, the reason and the host (#385)
mutations.cell: a spawn naming a directory the serving host cannot resolve is refused at admission with the path, the reason and the host (#385)

mutations.name: M3 the ps row reads provider from the launch request instead of the presence card
mutations.expectRed: ps carries the provider the seat's presence card reports
mutations.cell: ps carries the provider the seat's presence card reports

mutations.name: M4 an absent provider is fabricated as an empty string
mutations.expectRed: ...and a seat whose card reports no provider serializes provider ABSENT, never fabricated
mutations.cell: ...and a seat whose card reports no provider serializes provider ABSENT, never fabricated

mutations.name: M5 the row contract drops the provider field's type
mutations.expectRed: the row contract admits the reported provider and refuses a non-string one
mutations.cell: the row contract admits the reported provider and refuses a non-string one
